_engine_help: auto = try claude CLI, fall back to local ollama. 'claude' = force best quality (needs claude_oauth_token for unattended runs). 'ollama' = free/offline.
_token_help: Run `claude setup-token` once, paste the token (sk-ant-oat...) into config.json (NOT this example file). config.json is gitignored so the token never leaves your Mac.
